blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 1 sold over 4 months against an average of 1.8 listed, about 7.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 1 sold.

faq.a: Whonnock is a City of Maple Ridge neighbourhood and the board/Paragon sub-area name for the rural east side of Maple Ridge, centred on Whonnock Lake; the City describes Whonnock Lake Park, with its beach, swimming area, trails and playground, as a popular recreation destination there. Whonnock also sits inside the wider Northeast Maple Ridge working scope used by this site's northeast page (see Section 1).

faq.q: How did Whonnock sell in September 2026?
faq.a: It recorded no sales on a near-empty shelf: detached 2 active listings and 0 solds, Condos & Townhomes 0 listings and 0 solds, so no sales ratio applies to either split; at the Maple Ridge community level the detached median sale price was $1,131,000 and the Condos & Townhomes median was $525,000 (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

Whonnock Elementary (27471 112 Ave), Webster's Corners Elementary (25554 Dewdney Trunk Rd) and Garibaldi Secondary (24789 Dewdney Trunk Rd) are the schools named for the area, with names and addresses confirmed against the BC Ministry K-12 school file; catchments are address-specific and no Whonnock locator result was recorded in this pass — check any address in the SD42 School Locator.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Whonnock?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 2 houses listed with 0 sold in the month in Whonnock. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.
